name: farmer-advisor
description: Multilingual Sovereign AI Agronomic Advisory Assistant with Verified ICAR Groundedness

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd .. && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup_env.ps1
scripts.dev:backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .venv) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000 } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000 } else { py -3.10 -m uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000 }"
scripts.download:pdfs: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .venv) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/download_icar_pdfs.py } else { python scripts/download_icar_pdfs.py }"
scripts.download:models: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .venv) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/download_models.py --model lightweight } else { python scripts/download_models.py --model lightweight }"
scripts.eval: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .venv) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m backend.evaluation.evaluator } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python -m backend.evaluation.evaluator } else { py -3.10 -m backend.evaluation.evaluator }"
